title: Complete endpoints baseline contract and direct AutoPilot schema bundle entrypoint

phases.objective: Make endpoints migration pre-use columns explicit in the canonical baseline, make direct Start-AutoPilot schema bundle flags fail-closed and schema-only, and provide a reversible local-Staging database recovery lifecycle with repository-owned least-privilege role grants.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The generator runs from an exact clean main checkout with explicit BUILD_STAGING_SCHEMA_BUNDLE confirmation.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Migration 023 can add schema import tracking columns after the canonical endpoints baseline without unknown-column failure.
steps: Read required_endpoints_baseline_columns from the role manifest.
Validate every required endpoints column in schema.sql before disposable MariaDB starts.
Apply baseline and ordered migrations only after endpoints preflight passes.
Keep the schema bundle three-role, schema-only, exact-SHA, and free of Production/provider access.
assertions: The canonical endpoints baseline includes child_openai_schema_file_id before migration 023.
The generator emits required_endpoints_baseline_columns in plan evidence.
An incomplete endpoints contract fails before disposable MariaDB execution.
production_accessed is false and provider_accessed is false.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The direct entrypoint validates or applies the three-role schema-only bundle through Clone-StagingDatabases before certification and never accesses Production.
steps: Require all three role bundle files when either schema flag is set.
Invoke Clone-StagingDatabases.ps1 in schema_only mode with the exact expected commit.
Apply only when ApplySchemaBundle is explicitly set; otherwise perform dry-run validation.
Persist schema seed status in AutoPilot state and continue same-cycle certification.
assertions: Missing bundle is fail-closed when RequireSchemaBundle or ApplySchemaBundle is set.
The direct entrypoint uses schema_only mode and explicit local apply semantics.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Recover-StagingDatabases.ps1 runs from an exact clean eligible main checkout with separate reset and grant confirmations.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: All three local Staging database roles are reinitialized from a repository-built schema-only bundle, exact least-privilege grants are read back, prior bind-mounted data remains preserved in a timestamped backup, and the same exact commit is certified ready.
steps: Verify exact main SHA, clean tracked tree, local Docker context, and Staging-only safety flags.
Construct RESET and GRANT confirmation strings with braced ${ExpectedCommit} interpolation so the literal colon after the SHA cannot alter PowerShell variable binding.
Build and dry-run the three-role schema bundle using disposable MariaDB without Production/provider access.

Resolve the runtime support-table contract from the canonical staging-database-role-migration-manifest.json, cross-check the 18-table census projection, and prove the bundle runtime role contains the canonical support set without requiring a duplicated bundle-manifest field.
Stop the local Compose project without -v and move runtime, governance, and persistence data directories to a timestamped recovery backup instead of deleting them.

Start fresh local database containers from the current ignored .env.staging identities and prove each role can authenticate through a bounded 60 x 2s readiness loop that treats transient Windows PowerShell native stderr as retryable but still requires native exit code 0 and SELECT 1.
Apply the schema-only bundle through Clone-StagingDatabases.ps1.

Derive the exact role grant plan from BOOTSTRAP_ROLE_GRANT_POLICIES, revoke broad/default grants, grant only registered table privileges, and read back no global/schema/column/role/grant-option authority.
Restart the exact existing Staging image without rebuilding and require certification_status=ready before recovery completes.
assertions: Reset and grant reconciliation require separate exact-SHA Staging-local confirmations.
RESET and GRANT confirmation builders use the braced ${ExpectedCommit}: form and the contract verifier rejects the legacy unbraced $ExpectedCommit: form.

Clone resolves required_runtime_support_tables from the canonical role migration manifest, verifies the bundle runtime census against that same source of truth, and never dereferences bundleManifest.validation.required_runtime_support_tables.
No docker compose down -v, database-directory deletion, Production access, provider access, Hostinger mutation, or Cloudflare mutation is allowed.
The backup directory is preserved on success and failure and is never automatically deleted.

Fresh MariaDB self-auth readiness remains bounded to 60 attempts with a 2-second delay; expected transient native stderr cannot terminate the loop, and a nonzero native exit code never counts as ready.
Grant scope is sourced from repository-owned databasePrivilegeContracts.js and permits only SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE as declared per role/table.
No global privilege, schema-wide privilege, column privilege, applicable role, or GRANT OPTION remains after reconciliation.
Recovery cannot report success unless the exact commit returns certification_status=ready.
